# CyUI 1.0.0

Owned library snapshot imported on 17 October 2026 from CyImgui_Interface.
MIT license: `LICENSE`; the distribution also carries `LICENCES/CyUI-MIT.txt`.

Only the widget/theme/layout/gallery sources, public headers, CMake file and
integration guide are included. No bundled ImGui, example executables, fonts,
local configuration, repository history or build artifacts are copied.

CyInsights supplies `CyImGui` as `CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET` and disables the demo.
The integration guide's machine-specific example paths are adapted to this
repository. `source-sha256.json` identifies the imported implementation files.
